canonical_population.cohort_rule: collateral_weth > 0 after usageAsCollateralEnabled verification AND debt_usdc > 0

definitions.bad_debt: Final model-based uncovered-debt estimate: sum(max(0, debt USD - collateral market value)); it is not automatically realized protocol or investor loss.
definitions.cascade_amplification: total_liquidated_debt / direct_shock_liquidated_debt; undefined when direct debt is zero.
definitions.cascade_depth: Number of completed waves with positive liquidation volume; depth 1 is direct only, depth >=2 contains an endogenous later wave.
definitions.liquidation_at_risk: Debt value initially associated with positions below HF 1 immediately after the direct shock.
definitions.rq5_usdc_units: debt_usdc and total_liquidated_debt_usdc are USDC token quantities; USD-equivalent USDC debt multiplies token quantity by the scenario USDC/USD price.
definitions.time_to_recovery_seconds: Model-clock time until final DEX/reference spread is within 0.5%, or null if unrecovered; not an empirical wall-clock market forecast.
definitions.unliquidated_debt: Final debt value of positions whose model HF remains below 1 after the simulated run.

figure_table_consistency: The original package used engine-consistent definitions, but Uniswap-sensitive values and conclusions must be sourced from corrected_run_v1 because active liquidity was stale after price repositioning in the original run.

health_factor_populations.price_state_rule: Snapshot HF uses the canonical oracle state; scenario HF uses the scenario's shocked or evolving WETH and USDC price state.
health_factor_populations.snapshot_protocol_vs_model: all 454 RPC-verified borrowers at canonical state
health_factor_populations.stress_engine: all 454 positions are retained; eligibility and debt composition determine which positions can liquidate under each scenario
